entities.name: Hans Ernst Karl, Graf von Zieten
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans Ernst Karl, Graf von Zieten was a Prussian Field Marshal who was prominent during the Napoleonic Wars, particularly in the Hundred Days where he took part in several battles in the Waterloo Campaign such as the Battle of Ligny and the Battle of Issy.
